fields.label: Use Time-Varying Allow Exchange
fields.help: Check the box to use values that vary in time for grasses/herbs leaf 'allow exchange' indicating whether leaves are exchanging chemical with the air. This feature is typically used for this plant type. For non-evergreen leaves, it is typically assumed that the exchange does not occur during litterfall. Exchange is typically set to start after the typical date of last frost/freeze.

fields.label: Field Name for Values of Allow Exchange for Grasses/Herbs
fields.help: Indicate the field name for the time-varying values of allow exchange for grasses/herbs.

fields.label: Static Value of Allow Exchange for Grasses/Herbs
fields.help: Select a single value of 'allow exchange' to use for grasses/herbs throughout your model run. The default value is to allow exchange (1).
